[Gregory L. Fenves] Gregory Louis Fenves (born March 1, 1957) is an American structural engineer who served as the 21st president of Emory University. He began as president on August 2020 and transitioned to the role of chancellor in September 2025. Previously at the University of Texas at Austin, Fenves served as the 29th president from 2015 to 2020, as the provost from 2013 to 2015, and as the dean of engineering from 2008 to 2013.
